title: Schedule of Refund Terms for Paloma Top-Up & Bill Pay
content:
Refund terms of Paloma Top-Up & Bill Pay, by product: the number of Paloma business days within which a failed or cancelled order is refunded once the refund is due, whether fees are refunded with a failed order, whether a delivered order can be refunded other than through an upheld dispute, and whether the service fee is refunded when a bill posts later than its posting time.

| Product | Refund issued within (Paloma business days of becoming due) | Fees refunded when a failed order is refunded | Delivered order refundable other than through an upheld dispute | Service fee refunded on late posting |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Paloma Airtime Top-Up | 1 | yes | no | no |
| Paloma Data Bundle | 1 | yes | no | no |
| Paloma Electricity Token | 1 | yes | no | no |
| Paloma Bill Pay Utilities | 3 | yes | no | yes |
| Paloma Bill Pay Television | 2 | yes | no | yes |
| Paloma Bill Pay School Fees | 3 | yes | no | yes |

## Notes to the schedule

1. Fees are refunded with a failed order for every product.
2. No product's delivered order is refundable other than through an upheld dispute.
3. A late-posting service-fee refund exists only for the three bill products, whose bills post within a set number of Paloma business days; for Paloma Airtime Top-Up, Paloma Data Bundle and Paloma Electricity Token it does not apply.
4. The refund periods differ among the bill products: 3 Paloma business days for Paloma Bill Pay Utilities and Paloma Bill Pay School Fees, 2 for Paloma Bill Pay Television.
